scope: Read-only investigation of one failed mobile widget keyboard traversal; local scratch copies only.
originalFailure: widget-390-dark: Tab reaches inside-frame branding and fallback
originalCause: Not reproduced; unknown. The results do not prove a timing race.
sourceComparison: The rc.2 and current rc.3 pre-pack built widget.html and widget.js are byte-identical; hashes are in source-hashes.json.
recommendation: Use exactly two Tab actions. After the first, wait with a bounded timeout for both parent activeElement identity equal to the iframe and child document.hasFocus plus activeElement identity equal to attribution; only then Tab to the fallback. Preserve diagnostic states on failure. No repeated Tab retries.
negativeControl: The attribution alone was made untabbable in one disposable browser document. First Tab reached fallback; attribution wait failed with TimeoutError, proving fallback alone cannot pass the proposed assertion.
limits: The original failed run remains a failure in historical evidence
A passing fixed corpus does not establish the original cause
No independent human accessibility review, screen reader coverage, or universal browser claim
